However, it's important to note that the company has experienced negative compounded sales growth over the last ten years at -16%, indicating a challenging historical performance [E13]. This suggests that current positive trends may not be sustainable in the long term. Additionally, the sector median profit growth of 20% and sales growth of 12.9% indicate that Ajwa Fun World & Resort Ltd is outperforming its peers but still has room for improvement. In conclusion, while the company's financial metrics suggest potential value, the negative historical performance over the last decade raises concerns about sustainability. Investors should be cautious and consider these factors when evaluating the investment opportunity.
